review.summary: Round 6 reviews PR 129 at 653aa6e, focusing on the changes since round 5's cfdbe77: the stable tag row, the scheduler row of the enablement record and the task's production criterion. The v0.2.0 tag object is dated 12:22:20 UTC, which the row now gives; smoke items 3 and 5 and the plugin's apply at 10:23:01 UTC precede it, and the accepted deviation names smoke item 2 with its re-checks and the unrecorded time of smoke item 1, citing runbook section 11. The scheduler row's backup shadow-20261104T003001Z-scheduled-b713cc and Ofelia's postgres-backup result at 02:30:01 (+02:00) agree with each other and with ops-status, which lists only completed backups; the restore evidence matches the Restore evidence row. The task criterion no longer lists the backup check, and no other document listed it. git diff --check is clean, no link or anchor was added and the added lines hold no forbidden data. Round 5 F-001 is fixed.

prior_finding_dispositions.rationale: The stable tag row gives the tag time, the checks completed before it on which the main developer accepted the release, and an accepted deviation stating that smoke item 2 and its re-checks ran after the tag and that smoke item 1's time relative to it was not recorded.
